commits.subject: C4 launch: balance feasible ownership-aware move proposals

registration.allocation: One slot per feasible non-none family per randomly permuted cycle; family counts differ by at most one; none remains the separate baseline slot.
registration.acquisition: Expire commitments, process acting CAVs in stable id order, acquire the selected move before constructing the next slate, retain original context order for PPO.
registration.eligibility: Every member must be locally observable, a CAV, in registered range, presently controlled and unowned; this includes ego and gap_open's non-actuating partner.
registration.geometry_and_parameters: Reuse moves.py and VARIETY_REGISTERED; enumerate bounded wall member subsets while preserving full-local-pool gap/ramp role checks.
registration.arms: Identical proposal, acquisition and telemetry code for B and R, with no arm argument or outcome-conditioned tuning. Shared MoveAPI also defines the slate for uniform random teaching; dense teaching remains disabled in the current launch.

api.candidates: feasible_proposals.candidates(obs_state, rng, n) -> list[moves.Move]; local self/rows plus optional acquirable_cav_ids and proposal_stats output dict
api.live_decision: feasible_proposals.decide_and_start(trigger, context, *, obs_states, observable_cavs, executor, now, rng, generator, deterministic=False) -> (TriggerBatch, accepted_by_ego, stats)
api.aggregation: feasible_proposals.aggregate(receipts) -> update stats or None when unmeasured
api.production_bridge: track2_backend.MoveAPI.candidates uses the shared F2 candidate generator
api.update_telemetry: metrics.move_proposals in per-arm per-update learning-monitor JSON
api.infeasible_rate: sum(rejected_non_none) / sum(selected_non_none), or null without selections
api.family_infeasible_rate: sum(infeasible_family_checks) / sum(family_checks), or null without checks
api.ppo: Replay uses recorded conditional tables, masks, old log probabilities and original context ordering; proposals are not redrawn.

verification.skip_reason: Existing launch-integration file-symlink privilege test is deferred to cpuV qualification by that test.
covered_contracts: Balanced feasible-family counts and unbiased short-slate family ordering
Owned ego and partner exclusion, HDV exclusion and registered range
Cross-lane wall discovery beyond nearest same-lane neighbours
Invariance to unavailable and remote extra geometry
Same-tick joint acquisition prevents later conflicting proposals
Existing commitments block all members until exact expiry
Visible but not currently controlled partners excluded
Real-trigger conditional log-probability/value replay and context-order invariance
B/R stochastic and deterministic slate, acquisition, action and RNG parity
A retains original policy/controller objects, parameters and RNG
Ratio-of-sums update telemetry and persistence through learning monitor
